chain.title: Osmium: the workshop begins
chain.desc: Smelt osmium ore or raw osmium from this pack. Keep the first ingots for circuits and machinery; Mekanism's processing, equipment, and storage paths all begin here.

chain.title: The first infuser
chain.desc: Build a Metallurgic Infuser and supply energy. The infusion material and the item go into different inputs; start with redstone for circuits and infused alloy.

chain.title: Control the machines
chain.desc: Infuse osmium with redstone. Make spare circuits for machines and transport; a reliable infuser is more useful than a single completed craft.

chain.title: Redstone into alloy
chain.desc: Infuse iron with redstone to make infused alloy. This is the shared starting material for energy equipment and the stronger alloy tiers.

chain.title: Steel without a blast furnace
chain.desc: Infuse iron with carbon to make enriched iron, then infuse it again and smelt the resulting steel dust. Use the pack's recipe viewer for accepted carbon sources.

chain.title: Frame the factory
chain.desc: Craft a steel casing for your first processing machines. Casings are shared components; choose the machine that solves your current bottleneck instead of building every machine in order.

chain.title: Keep a power reserve
chain.desc: Place an Energy Cube between generation and your machines. Configure its input and output sides, then confirm it can charge while your workshop is idle.

chain.title: Make each ore count
chain.desc: Feed suitable ores or raw metals into the Enrichment Chamber, then smelt the dust. Check the installed recipe's yield; raw ore and ore blocks do not always use the same ratio.

chain.title: Finish the processing line
chain.desc: Add an Energized Smelter to turn processed dust into ingots. Configure automatic output so the enrichment line can run without moving each batch by hand.

chain.title: Crush materials on demand
chain.desc: Use a Crusher for dusts and bio fuel. This is a useful materials branch even if you keep a simple ore-processing line.

chain.title: Split water into gases
chain.desc: Supply water and energy to make oxygen and hydrogen. Route each gas deliberately, and configure surplus handling so a full unwanted tank does not stop production.

chain.title: Add an oxygen stage
chain.desc: Use oxygen in the Purification Chamber before crushing, enriching, and smelting its output. Keep the downstream machines fed and empty before expanding the input rate.

chain.title: Reinforce the alloy
chain.desc: Infuse infused alloy with diamond material. Enriched infusion materials use resources more efficiently, so revisit the Enrichment Chamber before making large batches.

chain.title: A chemical processing branch
chain.desc: Add hydrogen chloride and the Chemical Injection Chamber ahead of purification. This optional higher-yield route needs salt processing and reliable gas handling, not just one extra machine.

chain.title: Atomic alloy
chain.desc: Infuse reinforced alloy with refined obsidian material. Atomic alloy opens advanced equipment and logistics without requiring the largest ore-processing setup.

chain.title: Dissolve the ore
chain.desc: Use sulfuric acid to produce slurry. This is the start of the largest ore-processing branch; leave room for washing and crystallizing before feeding it valuable materials.

chain.title: Wash the slurry
chain.desc: Supply water to a Chemical Washer and route dirty slurry into it. Separate incompatible ore batches so a small remainder does not jam the next recipe.

chain.title: Crystals back into the line
chain.desc: Crystallize clean slurry, then feed the crystals through injection, purification, crushing, enrichment, and smelting. Check each buffer before scaling the complete chain.

chain.title: Mine by a deliberate filter
chain.desc: Power the Digital Miner and configure an item or tag filter, radius, and height range. Test a small job first; its energy draw and replacement settings matter as much as the filter.

chain.title: One tool, several jobs
chain.desc: Charge an Atomic Disassembler and choose a mining mode suited to the area. This equipment branch does not require advanced chemical ore processing.

chain.title: Start the plastic line
chain.desc: Combine the fluids, gas, and organic material shown in the recipe viewer to begin substrate production. Keep this branch's gas inputs separate from ore processing.

chain.title: Turn ethylene into durable plastic
chain.desc: Produce HDPE pellets through the reaction chain, then process them into sheets. Plan liquid ethylene and oxygen supplies before adding more reaction chambers.

chain.title: A core for distant connections
chain.desc: Craft a Teleportation Core for teleporters and quantum transport. This is a logistics branch; it can grow beside your processing factory.

chain.title: Build a return route
chain.desc: Construct the Teleporter frame shown in the in-game guide, supply energy, and assign a matching frequency at both ends. Keep each destination loaded when you need a reliable return.

chain.title: One frequency, many resources
chain.desc: Set up matching Quantum Entangloporters to move resources between locations. Configure the sides and frequency permissions before connecting valuable storage.

chain.title: Research the waste pathway
chain.desc: A Solar Neutron Activator converts nuclear waste into polonium in sunlight. A real waste source requires Mekanism Generators fission or a pack-provided alternative; do not build this expecting it to make waste.

chain.title: Stabilize polonium
chain.desc: Use polonium gas in the Pressurized Reaction Chamber recipe to make pellets. Follow the radiation-handling guidance before changing pipes or containers on a running waste line.

chain.title: Build the modular multitool
chain.desc: Craft and charge the Meka-Tool, then add only the modules useful to your play style. Its capabilities come from installed modules, not the base tool alone.

chain.title: A suit you can configure
chain.desc: Build the MekaSuit body armor and charge it. Complete the other armor pieces and select modules as resources allow; the polonium route is separate from maximum-yield ore processing.

chain.title: Plan antimatter production
chain.desc: Craft SPS casings and consult the complete multiblock layout, including ports and supercharged coils. Antimatter production needs polonium gas and a sustained, substantial energy supply.

chain.title: Condense the antimatter
chain.desc: Run the assembled SPS and turn its output into an antimatter pellet through the reaction recipe. This is an optional endgame materials branch with a much larger energy budget.

chain.title: Matter on your terms
chain.desc: Supply the Antiprotonic Nucleosynthesizer with antimatter and energy, then choose a supported conversion in the recipe viewer. Automate one useful recipe before expanding the system.

notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 against local Minecraft 1.20.1 JAR item assets and selected recipes/manuals, with official project sources listed separately. Every authored row now has explicit prerequisites; empty lists identify intentional branch roots. The coverage section states the verified versions and remaining limits. This replaces older list-order and item-count claims.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
limits: Nuclear-waste milestones need Mekanism Generators or a pack-provided waste source.
Does not cover every factory tier, QIO system, or module.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.
